sources.citation: Van Gysel, Jens L. 2017. Temporal predicative particles in Sanapaná and the Enlhet-Enenlhet language family (Paraguay): a descriptive and comparative study. MA thesis, Leiden University.
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: open copy online
sources.note: Glottolog's only 'grammar'-typed reference for nort2971; open access in principle but the bitstream URL is dead and the file is now behind Leiden's Alma viewer (hdl:1887/52531). Low chance of an Enlhet stress statement (topic is TAM particles) but should be checked.

sources.citation: Unruh, Ernesto & Hannes Kalisch. 1999. Escribir en idioma enlhet para hacer crecer lo propio. Suplemento Antropológico 34(1): 101-176 (errata SA 36(1): 379-385).
sources.note: Phoneme-based orthography discussion: three vowels /e a o/ with length, long consonants, glottal stop, syllables only CV(C), clisis. The only mentions of 'acento' are fn. 8 (they reject the acute accent as a LENGTH diacritic because 'la mayoría de las palabras enlhet se tendrían que escribir incluso con más de un acento') and fn. 11 (accentuation is coded in Spanish/Guaraní orthographies, whereas in Enlhet only quantity is coded). No statement of where word stress falls or whether it is contrastive.

sources.citation: Unruh, Ernesto & Hannes Kalisch. 1999. Vana Peema. Nentenyey'a Nelhpaqmeesma Nempeema. Guía del maestro maskoy para el aprendizaje del idioma guaná, lecciones 1-16. Ya'alve-Saanga: Nengvaanemkeskama Nempayvaam Enlhet. [SISTER LANGUAGE Guaná, guan1268]
sources.note: For Guaná (not Enlhet Norte), p. 75: 'En todas las palabras guaná, la última sílaba es la acentuada. Por lo tanto no hace falta escribir un acento' -- fixed final stress stated by the same authors for a sister language; recorded here only as family context.

sources.citation: Van Gysel, Jens E. L. 2024. A usage-based account of ongoing structural changes in Sanapaná: grammar sketch and case studies. PhD dissertation, University of New Mexico. [SISTER LANGUAGE Sanapaná, sana1298; already in catalog]
sources.note: Sec. 3.4.1: in Sanapaná bisyllabic and trisyllabic nouns the final syllable usually carries the pitch peak; survey of family literature (pp. 26-28) lists no phonological description of Enlhet Norte.

sources.citation: Elliott, John A. 2021. A grammar of Enxet Sur. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Mānoa. [SISTER LANGUAGE Enxet Sur, sout2989; already in catalog]
sources.note: Sec. 2.5.1 (pp. 115-118): stress/prominence in Enxet Sur cannot be summed up as 'penultimate'; interacts with weight and morphology; Powys 1929 said accent 'more often than not on the penultimate'. Lit. review 1.2.2 (pp. 43-45) confirms that for Enlhet Norte the only descriptive works are the NNE dictionary and Kalisch's syntax papers -- nothing on Enlhet Norte stress.

sources.citation: Kalisch, Hannes. 2019. Orden de los argumentos en enlhet. In V. Belloro (ed.), La interfaz sintaxis-pragmática, 143-177. Berlin: De Gruyter Mouton.
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: open copy online
sources.note: Constituent order/pragmatics; no mention of acento/prosodia.

sources.citation: Kalisch, Hannes. 2013. Los constituyentes de la cláusula enlhet. Esbozo de una cláusula omnipredicativa. In J. M. Rodrigues (org.), Políticas lingüísticas para la integración educativa y cultural en el Mercosur, 267-322. BPA 93. Asunción: CEADUC (= Amerindia 33/34: 109-150, 2009-10).
sources.note: Syntax. Fn. 75 explains orthographic symbols (lh = [ɬ], ng = [ŋ], ' = glottal stop, doubled letters = length); intonation named only as an undescribed parameter. No stress statement.

sources.citation: Kalisch, Hannes. 2009. Enlhet. In Lexikon der Mennoniten in Paraguay. Asunción: Verein für Geschichte und Kultur der Mennoniten in Paraguay.
sources.note: Encyclopedia entry on the people; nothing on Betonung.

sources.citation: Fabre, Alain. 2005- (updated online ed.). Los enlhet-enenlhet del Chaco paraguayo. Diccionario etnolingüístico y guía bibliográfica de los pueblos indígenas sudamericanos (= Suplemento Antropológico 40/1).
sources.note: Bibliographic survey; states that linguistic aspects of Enlhet have been treated only by Lepp (s.f., 1996), Kalisch (1994) and Unruh & Kalisch; no phonological data.

sources.citation: Unruh, Ernesto & Hannes Kalisch. 2003. Enlhet-Enenlhet. Una familia lingüística chaqueña. Thule. Rivista italiana di studi americanistici 14/15: 207-231.
sources.note: Family overview with comparative examples; notes that vowel lengthening is a distinctive feature in all nuclei except Toba-Enenlhet; no stress statement.

sources.citation: Unruh, Ernesto & Hannes Kalisch. 2003. Oralidad y literalidad autóctona. Suplemento Antropológico 38(1): 273-317.
sources.note: Nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Unruh, Ernesto, Hannes Kalisch & Manolo Romero. 2003. Enenlhet Apaivoma. Nentengiai'a nengiangvaiakmoho neliateikamaha enenlhet apaivoma. Guía para el aprendizaje del idioma materno toba. BPA 43. [SISTER LANGUAGE Toba-Enenlhet, toba1268]
sources.note: 214-page learner's guide; only remark is that a focused preverbal word 'recibe cierto acento, es enfatizada' (phrase-level emphasis); no word-stress rule, and not about Enlhet Norte.

sources.citation: Unruh, Ernesto & Hannes Kalisch. 2002. Nengvaanemquescama Nempayvaam Enlhet. Strategien zur Stärkung des Enlhet. Mitteilungen der Gesellschaft für bedrohte Sprachen (GBS-Bulletin) 7: 21-34.
sources.note: Sociolinguistic/revitalization; no stress statement.

sources.citation: Unruh, Ernesto & Hannes Kalisch. 1998 [vol. dated 1996]. El Diccionario Enlhet 'Moya'ansaeclha' Nengelpayvaam Nengeltomha Enlhet'. Marco, base, estructura. Suplemento Antropológico 31: 413-441.
sources.note: Mentions the orthography's marking of the glottal phoneme and of long vs short phonemes; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Unruh, Ernesto & Hannes Kalisch. 1997. Moya'ansaeclha' Nengelpayvaam Nengeltomha Enlhet. Biblioteca Paraguaya de Antropología 27. Ya'alve-Saanga: Comunidad Enlhet. 936 pp. (the work the earlier scan called the 'Enlhet grammar'; it is a monolingual Enlhet dictionary)
sources.note: Nothing. Front matter (pp. xvii-xx) explains the orthography in Enlhet only (glottal stop as apostrophe, long vowels/consonants written double, 'nempayvaam-nekha'a.. apqueltemeem sílaba'); no Spanish or Enlhet statement about accent/stress anywhere in the scanned text (a full-text search for stress/accent acento/acentu/tónic/sílaba over 2.2 MB of text: one hit, the word-for-'syllable' gloss).

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x reference list for nort2971 (16 refs) and English Wikipedia 'Enlhet language'.
sources.note: Glottolog lists no phonology or grammar of Enlhet Norte beyond the items above (plus von Becker 1941-42 ethnography, Peña 1898 wordlist). Wikipedia gives phoneme tables from Unruh & Kalisch 1999, nothing on stress. StressTyp2 (local SQL dump) has no Lengua/Enlhet entry; WALS 'Lengua' (Susnik 1977) is mapped to Enxet Sur.
